actual_evidence: The adsorption energy of HMF by C–OH adsorption mode on Nb2 site of Pt1/Nb2O5-Ov surfaces was −1.14 eV, which is much higher than the adsorption energy of HMF by C=O adsorption mode (−0.78 eV). ... we also calculated the H2 adsorption on Pt1/Nb2O5-Ov surfaces (Supplementary Fig. 10). explanation: 必需事实 1（C=O 加氢在动力学与热力学上均优于 C–OH）与必需事实 3（完全转化时 MF 选择性 >99%）在本块均不出现；只有必需事实 2 的位点分工有一半落在块内——Nb2 位点对 C–OH 的吸附能（−1.14 eV）高于 C=O（−0.78 eV），以及 H2 在 Pt1/Nb2O5-Ov 表面的吸附能（放热 0.51 eV）。3 项命中不足 1 项完整 → 2。旧判 3 过高（旧理由本身也只提 C–OH 优先吸附一项）。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: The reaction pathway over Pt1/ Nb2O5-Ov for the selective hydrogenation of HMF was also calculated by DFT (Fig. 6).
